channel.title: Data Stories
channel.description: Visualizations and narratives from public datasets

item.title: India's Petroleum Appetite: 239 Million Tonnes and Climbing
item.description: The world's third-largest oil consumer uses 1/22nd the oil per person that America does. Kerosene has collapsed 93%, India has overtaken China as the #1 source of oil demand growth, and 88% of crude is imported.

item.title: India's Urban Growth Ponzi Scheme
item.description: India is importing America's failed suburban development model while abandoning its own traditional cities -- which already embody everything the world's best urbanists now advocate.

item.title: The Guar Story: Rajasthan's Desert Gold
item.description: How a drought-resistant bean from the Thar Desert connects Rajasthan's farmers to America's oil rigs -- a $2.5B commodity that's cheapest where it's grown.
